heard: Wrong bill, lights out. The company says, pay it all or we cut you off. But the Electricity Act requires 15 clear days written notice first. Disputing the bill, deposit under protest the lower amount, what they claim or your six -month average for each month. then they can't cut you off while the dispute is pending. So put your dispute in writing, pay the lower amount, and keep the receipt. Follow Courtlands for everyday Indian law explained.
